[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=68"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "demo_pkg"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "A minimal demo Python package"
readme = "README.md"
license = {text = "MIT"}
requires-python = ">=3.8"

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
include = ["demo_pkg*"]
